high_level_description: This image depicts a statue of a man standing on a pedestal in an outdoor setting. The statue is positioned on the left side of the frame, with the man dressed in traditional attire, including a turban and a long garment. He is holding a staff or stick in his right hand and appears to be pointing forward with his left arm extended. The pedestal has inscriptions written in Tamil script, which likely provide information about the person commemorated by the statue. The setting appears to be a park or a public square, as there are trees, grass, and a fence surrounding the statue.
